title: German Lentil Wrap
description: A hearty German-inspired wrap filled with sautéed lentils, onions, and spices, wrapped in a crispy flatbread.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the lentils, cumin, and 2 cups water to the pan.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Warm the flatbread according to package instructions.
Spoon the lentil mixture onto the flatbread and serve.
Optional: Add additional toppings such as shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, or crumbled feta cheese.
